description: Hand-authored: type Durable Object code_update_strategy on Worker upload metadata (PUT /workers/scripts/{script_name}) and on deployment creation. The spec models it as an opaque `{ mode } | { mode, max_delay } | unknown` union (smithy.api#Document); Cloudflare unions use opaque key-set schemas, so model it as one structure with a mode enum and an optional max_delay. Wrangler (4.156.0, createWorkerUploadForm + createDeployment) sends it in upload metadata whenever it deploys through PUT /scripts and in the deployment body on the versions path. max_delay is seconds, 0-86400, millisecond precision, and only valid with mode deferred. Keep in sync with workers_for_platforms/putDispatchNamespaceScriptCodeUpdateStrategy.manual.json.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: `immediate` applies Durable Object code updates right away; `deferred` lets active Durable Objects hibernate before updating their code.
Maximum number of seconds (0-86400, millisecond precision) to wait before forcing the update. Only valid with mode `deferred`. When omitted, the default maximum delay (300) applies.
Choose whether to apply Durable Object code updates immediately or defer them. When omitted, the default strategy applies.
